newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Prices ease slightly at New Zealand wool sale.
newsitem.headline: Prices ease slightly at New Zealand wool sale.

text.p: Prices were generally easier at the Christchurch wool sale on Friday, Wools of New Zealand said.
The provisional market indicator fell five cents to NZ$4.71 with the fine segment down 38 cents to $8.52, medium segment down three to $4.99 and the strong segment level unchanged at $4.33.
Compared with the last sale in Dunedin on September 12, merino fleece varied from 1.5 percent to 2.5 percent cheaper. Halfbred fleece was level to slightly cheaper.
Crossbred fleece was one to two percent cheaper on 32 to 35 micron and unchanged at 36 micron and stronger. Second shear and crutchings were unchanged and bulky skirts five to 7.5 percent cheaper.
Some 22 percent of the 2,272 tonnes on offer failed to meet growers' reserves.
Interest came mainly from Western Europe and China with support from India, Australia, Turkey, Iran, Japan and local mills.
The next sales will be on September 26 in Napier and Dunedin. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
